crop.notes: Clipping includes Pettis County and Territorial Fair sports items, real-estate and bicycle ads, and a cricket item; the 'Gossip of the Pugilists' column (crops 4-6) is the relevant part, with one line on Allen in crop 5.

ocr.notes: Column text mostly right; ad fragments garbled.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, September 19, 1897, page 15.

notes: Single line in a list of champions who refought opponents, used to argue Fitzsimmons must fight Corbett.
